description: This file defines classes and interfaces for Mach IPC communication, including message wrappers, port descriptors, and port management classes, used within the Google Breakpad project for macOS.

classes.name: MachMsgPortDescriptor
classes.description: Wrapper for mach_msg_port_descriptor_t with constructors and accessors.

classes.name: MachMessage
classes.description: Base class for Mach IPC messages, providing data handling and descriptor management.

classes.name: MachReceiveMessage
classes.description: Subclass of MachMessage for received messages.

classes.name: MachSendMessage
classes.description: Subclass of MachMessage for messages to be sent.

classes.name: ReceivePort
classes.description: Represents a Mach port for receiving messages, with methods to wait for messages.

classes.name: MachPortSender
classes.description: Represents a Mach port for sending messages, with methods to send messages.

methods.name: AddDescriptor
methods.description: Adds a port descriptor to the message.

methods.name: GetDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves a descriptor at a specified index.

methods.name: GetTranslatedPort
methods.description: Gets the mach port from a descriptor.

methods.name: SetData
methods.description: Sets raw data for the message.

methods.name: WaitForMessage
methods.description: Waits for a message on the port with optional timeout.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through the port with optional timeout.
